senses.gloss: m. (adapt. of sapo, as if fr. צוּף; v. Sm. Ant. Engl. ed.3, s. vv. Sapo a. Fullo) [foam,] soap, detergent.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 62a:38">Nidd. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>העביר עליו צ׳ ועבר</he> (Ar. <cite ref="O01328"><he>ספון</he></cite>) if he rubbed soap over the suspected blood-stain, and it disappeared.

<cite ref="Niddah 62a:38">Ib.</cite> <he>צ׳ צבע נמי מעבר</he> but will not soap also remove red dye? <cite ref="Bava Kamma 93b:16">B. Kam. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>הואיל ויכול להעבירו ע״י צ׳</he> because he can remove it with soap.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 101a:8">Ib. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>במאי שקיל להו בצ׳ צ׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. R. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300) wherewith shall he take the dye off? With soap? Soap will remove the dye, but will not restore the natural color.
Tosef. Nidd. VIII, 11 שאילו העביר עליו צ׳ וכ׳ ed. Zuck. (Var. סָאפוֹן, סאפן) if he had rubbed soap over it at the start, it might have passed away.—Denom. הִצְפִּין to soap.

<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 8:11">Ib.</cite> <he>הצפינן ועבר עליו</he> ed. Zuck. (read <cite ref="R00702"><he>הִצְפִּינוֹ</he></cite>, and strike out <he>עליו</he>) if he soaped the stain, and it passed away (oth. ed. <he>סאפון ועבר</he>, sub. <he>העביר עליו</he>, v. supra).
